description: The crew survives the Magog World Ship but carries the damage home: Harper is infested with Magog larvae, Rev Bem enters a crisis of faith and Trance changes in ways no one fully understands. Dylan pushes the Commonwealth project from ideal to necessity, ending the year with its formal restoration just as a new extra-dimensional enemy appears.

s02e01.description: Dylan and Rommie return to the Magog World Ship to rescue Tyr, Harper and Rev while the damaged Andromeda prepares for the possibility that they will not return.

s02e02.description: Dylan, Beka, Rev and Tyr crash on an ice world while Harper and Rommie struggle with the physical and psychological aftermath of the Magog attack.

s02e03.description: Dylan tries to prevent a diplomatic crisis over a sacred Than relic while Beka's past with a station security chief complicates the mission.

s02e04.description: Andromeda investigates attacks on a suspiciously isolationist world while Trance is detained and questioned about the nature of her species.

s02e05.description: The crew searches for a long-missing Commonwealth leader whose identity and loyalties prove much harder to establish than expected.

s02e06.description: Rommie infiltrates an anti-AI society to investigate a dangerous weapon while the rest of the crew races to save the Maru and its stranded passengers.

s02e07.description: Harper is forced into command while Andromeda escorts medical ships through hostile Nietzschean territory during a deadly plague.

s02e08.description: Dylan discovers a colony founded by descendants of people who escaped the old Commonwealth's collapse, including those connected to the life he lost.

s02e09.description: During a diplomatic conference, Harper is offered a cure for the Magog larvae inside him in exchange for dangerous information stored in his mind.

s02e10.description: A dying king names Dylan and Tyr co-regents for his young heir, dragging Andromeda into a volatile succession struggle.

s02e11.description: War between Nietzschean prides draws Dylan into an escalating conflict as the Sabra-Jaguar alliance challenges the Drago-Kazov.

s02e12.description: Harper's Magog larvae near maturity while an experimental time-space device brings a transformed Trance and a painful turning point for the crew.

s02e13.description: Separated from Tyr during an attack, Dylan must cross hostile territory and improvise his way back to the Andromeda.

s02e14.description: News of a former Maru crewmate's death forces Beka and Harper to revisit the compromises, loyalties and crimes of their old life.

s02e15.description: Survivors rescued from a damaged ship bring a lethal infection aboard Andromeda when the dead begin returning to life.

s02e16.description: Beka leads Dylan and Trance on a dangerous quest for the legendary Engine of Creation.

s02e17.description: After a catastrophic accident near a black hole, Dylan awakens in an apparently ordinary life with a wife and family he does not remember having.

s02e18.description: Evidence of a living Vedran sends Andromeda searching for one of the vanished founders of the original Commonwealth.

s02e19.description: A legendary space creature proves very real when it swallows the Andromeda whole and traps the crew inside.

s02e20.description: The crew hunts for a hidden fleet of surviving High Guard ships and the AI who knows where they are.

s02e21.description: Dylan intervenes when anti-Nietzschean extremists attack several prides, while Tyr's connection to a potentially messianic child comes into focus.

s02e22.description: The reborn Commonwealth's charter ceremony is interrupted by an invasion from another dimension, forcing the crew into a battle around the portal itself.
